Almost everything in this release came from your feedback, thank you.

Your widget can now sign in on its own, so it keeps updating even when the app has been closed for a long time. Previously it would get stuck showing "HTTP error 401" until you opened the app again. After updating, open the app once so your widget can pick this up.

- Live query streaming on iPad
Live mode now works on iPad, not just iPhone. The Live button has moved next to the search field, where it's always visible instead of being tucked away in a menu.

- Easier server management
Every server now has its own menu for editing or removing it, with a confirmation step so nothing disappears by accident. You can also remove a server directly from its edit screen. This should help if a Pi-hole's hostname changes and you need to fix or replace it.

- Copy domains and clients
Long press the domain or client on any query to copy it.

- A tidier Query Log
Search and Live now share a single row, filters and display options are gathered into one menu, and the title stays put when you switch modes. The keyboard also gets out of the way as soon as you scroll.

Removing the server you were connected to no longer leaves its old connection status behind. Widgets set to the demo server now show sample data instead of an error.
